scope: What actually blocked HS2. The runtime feature set, not the NVRAM cache, the DBM area or any single payload field, decided whether the MD ever reached HS2.

images.content: first extended feature set (26 granted); MD reaches ccci_shm_bm instead of MPU_NOT_ALLOW
baseline: HS2 reached, CCISM RUNNING, no MD exception

feature_set.before: 9 granted (0,1,2,6,14,27,28,36,38); the MD always died in MPU_NOT_ALLOW after the NVRAM pass

added_payloads.5 MISC_INFO_HIF_DMA_REMAP: 16 zero bytes, exactly as config_ap_runtime_data_v2_1() leaves it
added_payloads.7 MISC_INFO_RANDOM_SEED_NUM: 16 bytes, first word a random seed
added_payloads.9 MISC_INFO_SBP_ID: {0, 0x7d, 0, 0} from this device's own vendor log (sbp=0x0,wmid[0x7d])
added_payloads.10 MISC_INFO_CCCI: {3, 0, 0, 0}: sequence check and MD status polling
added_payloads.12 MISC_INFO_C2K: {0x4, 0, 0, 0} from this device's own vendor log (c2k_flags 0x4)
added_payloads.16 DHL_RAW_SHARE_MEMORY: LK CCB aggregate past the 2 MiB CCB window, the vendor split
added_payloads.17 DT_NETD, 18 DT_USB, 26 AUDIO_RAW, 30: SMEM user md view and size
added_payloads.25 LWA_SHARE_MEMORY: {0, 0}: MUST on the same-board stack even without an LWA user

withheld.15 CCB_SHARE_MEMORY: advertising it makes the MD assert in ccci_shm_bm during boot while no CCB control/port subsystem exists; measured below
withheld.13 MD_IMAGE_START_MEMORY: needs the MD image size from the image header, which the driver does not parse; a guessed size would be worse than an honest refusal

bisection.method: new sysfs runtime_mask (hex u64, bit N suppresses offer N) applied before the single publication; one image, one reboot per experiment
bisection.0x18000 (15+16): no exception at all; MD keeps reading NVRAM (tx 2792, tx_error -16)
bisection.0x8000 (15 only): no exception; MD keeps reading NVRAM (tx 2802) and later reaches HS2
bisection.0x0: MD asserts in ccci_shm_bm (line 615 then 609 with the same module path)
bisection.conclusion: feature 15 alone is the trigger; DHL_RAW alone is harmless

milestone_run.sequence: SCP pin 26m + start, md_power takeover/on, runner, prepare 1, release 1
milestone_run.timing: HS1 accepted at 22.1 s, HS2 accepted at 62.5 s (the MD spends about 40 s in its NVRAM pass first)
milestone_run.handshake: state=4 (HS2_SEEN) error=0 active=1 bytes=832 rejected=64 hs2_seen=1 dbm=512
milestone_run.ccism: state=5 (RUNNING) generation=1 error=0 armed=1 md_open=1 scp_open=1 bridge_touched=1
milestone_run.services: connected=1 error=0 tx=6041 tx_error=0 after a transient -EBUSY burst
milestone_run.md_ee: present=1 bytes=14336 error=-61: no exception record

port_policy_change.before: any channel other than 0/2/14/32 failed closed with -EOPNOTSUPP, which killed the generation the moment the MD opened its next port
port_policy_change.after: after HS2, any channel below CCCI_MAX_CH_NUM (258) is counted (bit per channel under 64, counter above) and accepted without a reply; the AT/MUX text preview stays opt-in via md_at
port_policy_change.still_fail_closed: control-channel messages, FS/RPC semantics, and channel ids outside the same-board enum

not_claimed: that the modem is radio-ready: no registration, no AT dialogue and no data plane exists yet
that the NVRAM pass completed before HS2
that feature 15 will stay harmful once a CCB control/port subsystem exists
